svg.title: E09: Dual-loop assistance collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Evolution · A² A1/A3 · cycle role collaboration
A planner or assistance loop and an executor loop
Executor state or environment feedback updates
The next plan or assistance action changes in
Planner and executor states have compatible
The outer loop cannot bypass executor
1 plan(trace) → 2 act(action) → 3 feedback(observation) → 4 reflect(summary) → 5 authorize(assistance) → 6 assist(action)
Evidence: 3/41 repositories, 3/36 families; 3 trajectories (2 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Reactor-assisted executor, dual loop, planner-executor, and assistance policy.
Negative control: Two unrelated loops without a feedback link do not meet the pointcut.
